purpose: Defines the read-only materialized research projection consumed by player UI and AI explanation tooling. It contains only information the civilization legitimately knows and never exposes hidden possibility nodes or authoritative enemy research state.

civilization_research_view.revision: monotonic research-view revision used to invalidate UI cache
civilization_research_view.visible_edges: array of ResearchEdgeView connecting visible nodes only
civilization_research_view.recognized_pressures: array of recognized ResearchPressureView entries only
civilization_research_view.history_summary: paged/collapsed mature and archived research history

ResearchAgendaView.scientific_culture_summary: own civilization's high-level research-relevant institutional tendencies, not hidden exact AI weights
ResearchAgendaView.recent_reasoning: bounded human-readable explanations for major agenda changes
ResearchAgendaView.rule: Agenda displays only recognized targets; it never lists unknown nodes or future hidden capabilities.

ResearchNodeView.display_name: localized known name or uncertainty-safe label
ResearchNodeView.state: rumored | hypothesized | investigable | experimental | demonstrated | engineering | mature | archived
ResearchNodeView.solution_family: shown only when civilization understands the relationship
ResearchNodeView.known_capabilities: capabilities currently understood to follow from this node; never hidden future outputs
ResearchNodeView.estimated_completion: range/uncertainty or unavailable; never fake precision
ResearchNodeView.readiness_summary: compact player-readable breakdown without exposing hidden exact rolls
ResearchNodeView.agenda_alignment: player-readable explanation of why the visible project is currently emphasized/deemphasized; not a hidden score dump
ResearchNodeView.evidence_summary: only legitimate evidence known to civilization
ResearchNodeView.layout_anchor: stable visible anchor/group hint, not absolute hidden-tree coordinate

ResearchEdgeView.rule: Both endpoints must already be visible. No edge may imply an unknown placeholder node.

ResearchProjectView.strategic_reason: recognized explanation for why civilization/player is currently pursuing it

ResearchPressureView.display_value_or_band: exact value or band according to UI policy
ResearchPressureView.hard_gate_targets: only currently visible nodes affected by explicit pressure gates

FieldCompetenceView.rule: Field summaries do not reveal undiscovered nodes that use the field.

ForeignTechnologyView.exchange_packages: packages actually possessed/known/negotiable through external systems

ResearchCapacityRequestView.request_type: general_labs | specialized_labs | facility | training | sample_or_asset | foreign_expertise_or_package
ResearchCapacityRequestView.status: planning request state supplied by owning external system where known
ResearchCapacityRequestView.rule: Displaying a request never implies the requested building/expert/package has been created or funded.

command_contract_from_UI_or_AI.payload: visible node id + requested lab allocation + target context
paused project node id + lab allocation
active project node id + new aggregate lab assignment
recognized field/domain/problem/capability priority or high-level research orientation
command_contract_from_UI_or_AI.validation: changes agenda/background/planning preference, never unlocks hidden nodes directly
